goal: Tie acceptance verification to observable invariant seams, combination/boundary controls and executable isolated-environment prerequisites rather than test counts or local tool availability.

acceptance.assertion: Implement S4 of docs/specs/workflow-decision-closure.spec.md through Planner and existing QA/Review role contracts. Map acceptance to positive/negative/bound controls for the six generalized normalization, merge-validation, lifecycle deadline, missing-signal ranking, serialized-budget and duration-evidence classes. Descriptors must state focused paths, prerequisite provenance, preparation and writable outputs; absent/skipped/zero-match required checks fail, structural Enrollment readiness never proves execution. Require authorized preparation and failure/interruption cleanup, separate automated behavior/geometry from human motion judgment, and retain Role/Kernel evidence boundaries. Update packaged role mirrors and focused tests. Do not edit original app code, change the QA engine/Kernel core, install browser/simulator infrastructure or claim provider compliance from contract strings.
